Dark: Night, or Auto with a dark browser. */ /* LIGHT */ html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-skilltip-name { color: #b4540f; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) { html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-skilltip-name { color: #b4540f; } } /* DARK */ html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-skilltip-name { color: #ff9c27; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-skilltip-name { color: #ff9c27; } }
html:
/* {{SkillLink}}: icon + name, the skill card opens beside it on hover (tip=left: on the left side) */
.aa-skilltip {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.aa-skilltip-ico {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 22px;    /* the default size; size= on the template sets it per icon */
  height: 22px;
  line-height: 0;
}
/* the frame is drawn over the edge of the icon: a thin black line outside, the orange of the name inside it (like {{BuffLink}}) */
.aa-skilltip-ico::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #000, inset 0 0 0 2px #ff9c27;   /* the orange: same as the name */
}
.aa-skilltip-name {
  color: #ff9c27;   /* the colour of the name (the orange of the game's skill lines): change here */
  font-weight: bold;
}
.aa-skilltip-card {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: 100%;
  z-index: 200;
  padding-left: 6px;   /* no gap, so the card stays open while the pointer moves onto it */
  white-space: normal;
  font-weight: normal;
  font-style: normal;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: default;
}
.aa-skilltip-left .aa-skilltip-card {
  left: auto;
  right: 100%;
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 6px;
}
.aa-skilltip:hover .aa-skilltip-card {
  display: block;
}
/* Phones: no room beside the skill, the card opens below it */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .aa-skilltip-card,
  .aa-skilltip-left .aa-skilltip-card {
    top: 100%;
    left: 0;
    right: auto;
    padding: 4px 0 0;
  }
}

/* ===== THEME COLOURS (dark + light) ===== */
/* Colours for the wiki's two themes. Light: wiki set to Day, or Auto with a light browser. Dark: Night, or Auto with a dark browser. */
/* LIGHT */
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-skilltip-name { color: #b4540f; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-skilltip-name { color: #b4540f; }
}
/* DARK */
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-skilltip-name { color: #ff9c27; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-skilltip-name { color: #ff9c27; }
}
